rule_title: TTP T1562.001 - Defender Security Service Disabled via sc.exe
description: Detects sc.exe setting the start type of a Windows security service to disabled. The three services seen in this sample cover the full defensive stack: WinDefend (Defender AV engine), sense (Microsoft Defender for Endpoint EDR sensor), and mpssvc (Windows Firewall). Disabling these at the service control layer prevents them from restarting after a reboot, making this a persistence-aware evasion technique. The 'start= disabled' syntax with a space before the value is the sc.exe command format — note the space is required by sc.exe and is therefore a reliable detection string.
